slots.angle: Ambition is not the problem; the plan is. This guide hands the reader a blank template to build their own: anchors instead of times, a recitation plan expressed as a shape, dhikr in the real gaps, a solo and a family version, and a documented fallback. It describes no day and duplicates no moment of that post, which it links once as the picture of what it is planning for.
